sql: SELECT 'a & b'::tsquery || 'c'::tsquery AS orq, 'a'::tsquery && 'b'::tsquery AS andq, !!'a'::tsquery AS notq

name: ts_headline basic
sql: SELECT ts_headline('english', 'The quick brown fox jumps', to_tsquery('english', 'fox')) AS v

name: ts_rank weights and norm
setup: INSERT INTO tsr VALUES (setweight(to_tsvector('english', 'cat dog'), 'A') || to_tsvector('english', 'dog bird'))
sql: SELECT round(ts_rank(doc, to_tsquery('english', 'dog & cat'))::numeric, 6) AS a, round(ts_rank(ARRAY[0.2,0.3,0.5,0.9]::float4[], doc, to_tsquery('english', 'dog'))::numeric, 6) AS b, round(ts_rank(doc, to_tsquery('english', 'dog'), 2)::numeric, 6) AS c FROM tsr

sql: SELECT s FROM shirts WHERE s > 'small' ORDER BY s

setup: CREATE DOMAIN posint2 AS int CHECK (VALUE > 0)
sql: INSERT INTO dp VALUES (-5)

name: search_path schema resolution
sql: SELECT * FROM items

name: information_schema columns
setup: CREATE TABLE isc (a int NOT NULL, b text)
sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'isc' ORDER BY ordinal_position

name: pg_catalog attributes
setup: CREATE TABLE pca (x int, y text)
sql: SELECT attname FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid WHERE c.relname = 'pca' AND attnum > 0 ORDER BY attnum

sql: SELECT * FROM txr

name: savepoint partial rollback
sql: SELECT * FROM spr ORDER BY v

name: concat and concat_ws variadic
sql: SELECT concat('a', NULL, 1, true) AS a, concat_ws('-', 'x', NULL, 'y') AS b

name: regexp functions wave2
sql: SELECT regexp_count('aba aba', 'a', 1) AS c, regexp_instr('hello world', 'o') AS i, regexp_like('abc', '^a') AS l, regexp_substr('abc123', '[0-9]+') AS s

name: regexp_split_to_table and array
sql: SELECT regexp_split_to_array('a1b22c', '[0-9]+') AS arr

name: starts_with left right reverse
sql: SELECT starts_with('postgres', 'post') AS a, left('hello', 2) AS b, right('hello', 2) AS c, reverse('abc') AS d

name: distinct on with order
setup: CREATE TABLE don2 (g text, v int)
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (g) g, v FROM don2 ORDER BY g, v DESC

name: copy to stdout equivalent select
setup: CREATE TABLE cts (a int, b text)
sql: SELECT a::text || E'\t' || coalesce(b, '\N') AS line FROM cts ORDER BY a
